issue_request: FHIR-40772 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP change request asking to allow If-Match headers on delete interactions by adding Conditional Delete to the If-Match HTTP Header notes, adding conditional delete If-Match behavior text, and marking If-Match optional in the summary table's Conditional column.
initial_application: Commit d69932573d630eaa30b7e564a368a45eb72c69ca, with an equivalent historical patch at 7a0dc065da24291877e19eca91892cd909ae9d11, already added the Conditional Delete header note, conditional delete If-Match prose, and delete summary table If-Match entry in source/http.html. Later HTTP table work added delete-history rows that follow the same If-Match pattern.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and a Zulip block-vote announcement record FHIR-40772 as part of the 2023-11-06 12-0-0 Persuasive block vote. The implementer Zulip thread 'Delete and If-Match' motivated the request. A later R6 issue, FHIR-53878, is Resolved - change required and asks for a more precise conditional-delete-single versus conditional-delete-multiple clarification, but it is not Applied/Published and was left for separate follow-up.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because current source/http.html already satisfies the seed's explicit resolution items: Conditional Delete appears in the If-Match header notes, the Conditional Delete section describes If-Match with weak ETags, and the summary table includes O: If-Match for delete interactions.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 Resolved - change required issue asks to clarify that If-Match is only valid for conditional-delete-single and not conditional-delete-multiple; it is context but not decided in this applied/published run.
Delete/purge REST operation work later added delete-history summary rows that now also show O: If-Match, preserving the current table pattern.
